label: Psychiatric and behavioral symptoms after pediatric herpes simplex virus type 1 encephalitis: An exploratory case series.
summary: To exploratively describe long-term psychiatric and behavioral symptoms in pediatric survivors of herpes simplex virus type 1 encephalitis. In this retrospective descriptive case series conducted at two tertiary pediatric centers, admissions from 2000 to 2022 were screened for confirmed herpes simplex virus type 1 encephalitis.
